title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Ruth Eckerd Hall, Clearwater | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Ruth Eckerd Hall in Clearwater, Florida, USA, on 7 July 2006.

It was the 15th show by the ninth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006. This was Starr’s 66th birthday.

Starr had previously performed at the Ruth Eckerd Hall on 18 May 1997. He returned there on 2 July 2008, 13 July 2010, 1 July 2012, 23 October 2014, 10 November 2017, and 16 September 2022.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
